weather.summary: Partly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: The last hot one for a while. Rain takes over Wednesday night.

air.blurb: Clear air. A great day to be outside.

lake.blurb: Comfortably full, but every dry week takes a little. Down a touch from last week.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 11 hours and 55 minutes today, and down by 7:18 p.m.
